lines: @Wynn Fire from their hands. Gods keep us.
@Bram Put it down! Whatever you're doing, put it down!

do.hint: Bottom-left thumb: walk. Drag anywhere else: look around.

say: @Bram There you are. Dad's had me on the bellows since dawn.
@Bram Festival tonight. Lanterns at the stone when the sun goes down.
@Bram And then dancing. Don't pretend you won't.

choices.label: I'll be there.
say: @Bram Good. Save me the first bread off Mira's cart.

choices.label: Only if you dance first.
say: @Bram Deal. You'll regret it.
@Mira Oven's full. If anything burns tonight, let it be my bread and not my roof.
@Wynn Older than the valley, that stone.
@Wynn My grandmother said it hums on harvest nights. Don't lean on it.
@Wynn Now go home and wash the forge off you. Lanterns at dark.
@Tam Emberwings! Get inside!

do.hint: Something answers you. Touch a bird and hold: fire from your hands. Touch the well and drag: water.

say: @Tam The stone— did you hear the stone?
steps.objective: Drive them off. Save what you can.

say: @Tam Your roof! The fire— it came off you—
@Hollis Buckets! To the well!
@Bram It's spreading! The roofs!
@Mira It came out of you! The fire came out of you!
@Hollis Keep it coming! Whatever you are, keep it coming!
@Tam The birds are gone!
@Cael Enough.
@Cael Stand still. Breathe. It answers you, so it stops when you do.
@Wynn Half the village. In one night.
@Mira My ovens. My house.
@Wynn We lost some. We kept more.
@Wynn Not one roof lost. I don't know how.
@Bram The barn's gone. Dad's forge is standing. That's something.
@Bram You kept it off our barn. I saw you.
@Mira I saw it come out of you. I saw it.
@Tam It started on your roof. I saw that.
@Tam I saw you at the well after, too.
@Hollis Birds. Fire. A stone that breaks. I don't know what I saw tonight.
@Cael Here.
@Cael Old silver. Older than me. It quiets whatever in you hasn't learned to listen yet.
@Cael Wear it, and what's wild in you goes still. What I teach you will still answer.
@Cael Or don't. But what's in you won't wait until you're ready.

choices.label: Put it on.
say: @Cael It isn't a cage. It's a quiet room.

choices.label: Not yet.
say: @Cael Then keep it close. The day you want it, put it on.
@Cael You can't stay in the village tonight. Not like this.

choices.label: Help clear the ashes first.
say: @Cael Good. Then we go.

choices.label: Find the birds that did this.
say: @Cael They're long gone. Out there you'd only find more fire.

choices.label: (Say nothing.)
say: @Cael Then walk with me. Silence is fine.
@Cael My name is Cael. I read old stones for a living.
@Cael That one cracked tonight. So did something in you.
@Cael There's a verse on the oldest of them. Two. One who saves the world. One who changes it.
@Cael I came here following the stones. I didn't expect to find a person.
@Cael Fire is the loudest thing in you. I'll teach you something quieter first.
